request.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Create ONE edge-to-edge landscape location key PNG at exactly 1536×1024, no panels, inset, collage, border or text. Recipe establish: full environment detail, visible named key light and believable real-world scale. Tiny generic figures only where requested.

L7 carpark_gate/key.png. INSIDE a D-grade gate: a FLOODED BASEMENT CAR PARK in Mangwon. The camera is at the TOP OF A LONG DRY VEHICLE RAMP, looking DOWN the ramp into the dark lower parking level. The descending ramp is the clear foreground leading line and occupies about the lower middle half of the composition: 30 m long and 6 m wide, enough for two cars side by side, with low concrete kerbs. Upper two thirds remain DRY rough concrete; the LOWER THIRD becomes wet and slick, then disappears beneath still black floodwater. A broad opening over the ramp permits the high viewpoint to see into the lower basement under the low ceiling. Lower level has square concrete pillars 6 m apart, faint worn yellow paint stripes on pillars with no letters or numbers, thick pipes attached along the 2.6 m ceiling, WHITE-BLUE CAGED dungeon lamps mounted on the pillars as the ONLY key light, drips falling from pipe joints. The floor of the LOWER parking level is under roughly 1.2–1.4 m of dark still water; abandoned plain unbranded cars stand on that submerged floor, with wheels/body/windows under the water and only roofs or the very tops of windows above. Cars never float or sit on the water surface. Show three or four cars at staggered depths among the pillars, normal passenger cars 1.5 m tall, roof about 0.2 m above the water, not full visible wheels. Black water has crisp restrained white-blue lamp reflections and a few tiny rings below actual drips, no storm waves or supernatural portal. Do not draw any gate slit, neon opening or exterior sky in this interior. Exactly ONE TINY GENERIC ADULT scale figure in plain muted grey clothes stands on the dry upper ramp in the middle distance, 1.78 m tall with 7.5–8 heads and legs half the height, weight on one leg and hands holding a small shoulder strap. The adult is far enough from the camera to remain tiny and its feet are firmly on the ramp slope, not the water; its head/shoulders must fit below the ceiling with realistic clearance. Jaeha front is for HUMAN PROPORTIONS only, never draw his orange vest, T, pencil, notebook, face or named identity. Camera is 1.6 m above the UPPER landing, looking down around 10 degrees along the ramp; show tops of car roofs and pillar bases/paint bands in one coherent perspective. Horizon and converging lines reflect that high camera, not a low water-level view. Scale fixtures against human and cars; low ceiling is 2.6 m above lower floor (not above the water), and 6 m pillar spacing is about four car widths. Full detailed drawn key, navy/grey concrete and cold-white-blue light, source washes only around lamps, matte concrete and inked wet reflections. No floor labels, signs, parking-bay letters, license plates or other glyphs.

Approved references define the house rendering, materials, gate edge and adult proportions only. The final image is the approved acting-style anchor: match its crisp tapered ink, clean opaque cel shapes and restrained source-light colour. Do not copy its named characters, T glyph, outfits, props, standing poses or camera. The new location layout and lighting come only from this scene. No image from L6 or any other unapproved entry is an input.



No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

reference_policy: Four inspected approved Arc 1 images per call, including one acting anchor. Human front is only a scale/style comparison. No L6, local candidate, failed/rejected or other inbox image is an input.
inspection_derivatives: /tmp/msgf-L7 only; not delivered or used as references
attempt_cap: Initial plus up to three redos per image, per LOCATION_KEYS Rules and parent clarification; actual counts 4,1,1
